The questionnaire PDFs are image-only scans; wording was read visually from 250-dpi renders of page 5 (.cache/spain_2012_reality_participation/crop_p36_A.png, crop_p36_B.png) -- spot-check advisable. Versions A and B print P.36 identically (compared side by side; FT2973 says the versions differ only in P.9, 12, 15, 21, 24, 26, 29). DEVIATIONS: (1) p3601 ships the questionnaire's 'Comprar ...' where the ES2973 variable label reads 'Comparar ...' (a label typo -- the questionnaire, card context and p3602's 'Dejar de comprar' all make buying the referent); the label also reads 'el medio ambiente' where the questionnaire prints 'el medio-/ambiente' across a line break, shipped as 'medioambiente'. (2) Line-break hyphens joined ('medio-ambiente' -> 'medioambiente', 'pro-ductos' -> 'productos'); otherwise literal, including p3602's 'para favorecer medioambiente' (no article, as printed) and p3605's 'petición /recogida' (space before the slash, as printed; label has 'petición/recogida').
